stations.title: Last year's report
stations.text: Printed null for a boat that never ran

stations.title: Your report
stations.gap: No way to say there is none

stations.title: Council
stations.say: No bookings on the Curlew. Clear.

captions: The season's end. Ossian asks for the biggest party on the Curlew, for the council.
Last year the report printed null for the Curlew, a boat that never ran at all.
You add up the season, gather it into groups and a line, and answer when there is none.
Now the Curlew reads as no bookings, and every number in the report means something.
The season in numbers, nothing hidden behind a null. Part 7 is done: rules as values.
